verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at accounts payable. A customer quote on the MCP page mentions managing bills via AI instructions, the features page documents trigger workflows to 'notify, update, or validate' and 'workflow Blueprints', and the banking API can categorize transactions as vendor payments. None of this documents bill capture, approval routing, or payment scheduling as one AP workflow. Missing for 10: documented bill capture/OCR, a bill approval routing workflow, scheduled vendor payments, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
